# Challenges

Short exercises on minapp and `native_demo`. Each one has a goal and hints.
Open the hints only after you have tried it.

Rules:

- the lab must be up (emulator, frida-server, minapp running)
- pids and addresses change: read them from your own sessions
- one session at a time: close before opening another

| # | Goal | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|
| [1](challenge_01.qmd) | find the hidden class | easy |
| [2](challenge_02.qmd) | extract the secret without calling getSecret | easy |
| [3](challenge_03.qmd) | unlock premium without the key | medium |
| [4](challenge_04.qmd) | make the coins negative | medium |
| [5](challenge_05.qmd) | bypass the native checker | hard |
| [6](challenge_06.qmd) | find the last dynamically loaded class | medium |
